name: 68142 · Omaha, NE
findings: ZIP 68142 (Omaha) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68142 (Omaha) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68142 (Omaha) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
